People: Jolanda (author, Wikidata Q15618613), died 1917. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Jolanda, 1864-1917") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Il libro dei miraggi, Rocca S. Casciano (FC) : Licinio Cappelli Editore, 1894, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/illibrodeimiragg00majo. The scan does not show the credit of Jolanda, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
